stories.headline: BBC Expert Calls Iran War A Severe Blunder In Trump Critique Jeremy Bowen said the US president's decision to launch air strikes had been "a gross miscalculation".
stories.summary: BBC expert Jeremy Bowen criticized Donald Trump's decision to launch air strikes on Iran, calling it "a gross miscalculation." The move is seen as a severe blunder, with Iran not backing down as expected. The younger Khamenei also portrayed the conflict as a strategic misfire by the US, based on flawed assumptions about Iran. The best-case scenario now is a memorandum of understanding between the US and Iran, allowing peace talks to continue without a return to fighting. The conflict has sparked discussions on its global impact, including its effects on the Filipino poor. The situation highlights a miscalculation of Iran's fighting skills and resolve, with Iran proving to be a more formidable opponent than anticipated, unlike other countries such as Venezuela. The criticism comes as Trump is no longer in office, with other politicians seeing increases in support.

stories.headline: Trump slams ‘unpatriotic Republicans’ as US, Iran exchange tit-for-tat fire The US said it struck Iranian military sites at ‌the weekend and Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said it had targeted a US base in response, the latest exchange of
stories.summary: The US struck Iranian military sites over the weekend, prompting Iran's Revolutionary Guards to target a US base in response. The exchange of attacks occurs amid negotiations to end the three-month-old conflict. Iran warned that any cease-fire violation would justify a "decisive reciprocal response." US President Donald Trump claims his party is united behind his decision to bomb Iranian nuclear sites, but some Republicans have spoken out against it. The IRGC confirmed striking a US base used by American forces, retaliating against US attacks on an Iranian target near the Strait of Hormuz. The fragile cease-fire is under strain, posing a challenge to Trump's diplomatic efforts in the Middle East. The situation remains volatile, with both sides exchanging blows and warnings, complicating ongoing negotiations to resolve the conflict. Trump faces opposition from within his own party over his handling of the crisis.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV's Vision for Human Dignity in the Age of AI Pope Leo XIV examines AI, human dignity, labor, and Catholic Social Teaching in a new technological revolution.
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has released his first encyclical, 'Magnifica humanitas: On Safeguarding the Human Person in the Time of Artificial Intelligence,' marking the 135th anniversary of Rerum novarum. The encyclical, signed on May 15, 2026, and released on May 25, 2026, focuses on safeguarding humanity, promoting truth, dignity of work, social justice, and peace in the age of artificial intelligence. It explores the Church's Social Doctrine and its principles to interpret the impact of AI on human dignity. The Vatican states that the encyclical will address the protection of the human person in the age of AI, labor, and Catholic Social Teaching, providing a foundation for understanding the new technological revolution and its effects on society. This encyclical is the first major text of Pope Leo XIV's papacy, highlighting the importance of human dignity in the face of rapid technological change.

stories.headline: Ondo APC, Aspirant Trade Words Over Alleged Hijack Of Primary A House of Representatives aspirant for Ilaje/Ese Odo Federal Constituency on the platform of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Prince Monday Akinyomi, has
stories.summary: Prince Monday Akinyomi, an APC aspirant for Ilaje/Ese-Odo Federal Constituency in Ondo State, has petitioned President Bola Ahmed Tinubu over alleged manipulation of the party's primary election. Akinyomi claims the May 16, 2026, primary was hijacked to favor a preferred candidate. He has challenged the credibility of the election, stating it was not conducted fairly. The APC in Ondo State has been accused of manipulating the primary election process. Akinyomi's petition seeks intervention from the president to address the alleged irregularities. The incident has sparked a dispute between Akinyomi and the Ondo APC, with the aspirant condemning the outcome of the primary election. The matter is currently being contested, with Akinyomi seeking a resolution to the alleged hijack of the primary election. The APC's response to the allegations is awaited.

stories.headline: Google Pixel Watch 5 may have leaked in the weirdest way possible Found by a scuba diver underwater
stories.summary: A Google Pixel Watch 5 prototype has been found underwater near the Caribbean island of St. by a scuba diver. The unusual discovery was shared by Gearbox co-founder Randy Pitchford, who claimed a friend made the find while scuba diving. Despite being submerged, the smartwatch was reportedly still partially functional. Pitchford shared hands-on images of the alleged device, sparking widespread interest in the tech community. The leak is being compared to the infamous iPhone 4 leak in 2010, with many considering it one of the most unusual tech leaks in recent history. The discovery has generated significant buzz, with many awaiting official confirmation from Google about the Pixel Watch 5's features and release date. The images shared by Pitchford have provided an early glimpse into the device's design and capabilities.

stories.headline: Microsoft and NVIDIA Unveil AI-Powered Windows PCs for Developers and Creators The first wave of RTX Spark-powered devices will launch this fall and will include products from Microsoft Surface, ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo and MSI.
stories.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft have unveiled RTX Spark-powered Windows PCs, designed for developers, creators, and gamers. The first wave of devices will launch this fall, featuring products from Microsoft Surface, ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and MSI. RTX Spark powers personal AI agents with 1 petaflop of AI performance, industry-leading power efficiency, and up to 128GB of unified memory. The platform brings NVIDIA's full-stack AI and graphics technology to slim laptops with all-day battery life. RTX Spark is intended to enable the creation of AI supercomputers at home, with both laptops and mini PCs expected to arrive this fall. The devices will cater to creators, gamers, and AI developers, offering advanced AI capabilities and performance. Major PC manufacturers will release RTX Spark-powered systems, marking a significant development in AI-powered computing for personal use.

stories.headline: Dell's Alienware reveals world's first 39-inch 5K OLED monitor with RGB screen tech Alienware's new 39-inch 5K OLED monitor uses RGB stripe tandem technology to hit 1,300 nits of peak brightness without losing the deep blacks and rich colors th
stories.summary: Dell's Alienware has unveiled the world's first 39-inch 5K OLED monitor, the AW3926QW, featuring RGB stripe tandem technology. This technology enables the monitor to reach 1,300 nits of peak brightness while maintaining deep blacks and rich colors. Alongside this, Alienware introduced an updated 34-inch ultrawide monitor, the AW3426DW, with a 21:9 aspect ratio and 1800R curve. The AW3426DW uses a 5-stack QD-OLED Penta Tandem panel with a new V-stripe RGB subpixel layout, improving text clarity. Both monitors were revealed at Computex, with the AW3926QW boasting a 5K resolution and the AW3426DW offering a 3440×1440 resolution. Additionally, Alienware is releasing new 32 and 34-inch displays, expanding its range of gaming monitors with advanced OLED technology. These new monitors aim to provide enhanced gaming experiences with improved brightness, color, and clarity.

stories.headline: Microsoft is tightening password reset security in Entra ID Later this year, Microsoft will implement a significant change in how users can reset their passwords within Entra ID.
stories.summary: Microsoft is enhancing password reset security in Entra ID. Starting July 6, 2026, the company will begin changing its self-service password reset (SSPR) process. As of September 7, 2026, users will only be able to reset their passwords using registered authentication methods. This change replaces older directory-based methods, tightening security for Entra ID password resets. The updated SSPR process aims to improve account protection by requiring users to have registered authentication methods, such as multi-factor authentication, to reset their passwords. This move is part of Microsoft's efforts to strengthen security and prevent unauthorized access to user accounts, particularly when the Smart Lockout feature is triggered, which temporarily locks accounts to prevent potential security breaches.

stories.headline: Kohli dubbed 'heartbeat' of IPL champions in coach Flower tribute Virat Kohli was hailed as the "heartbeat" of the Royal Challengers Bengaluru dressing room after his unbeaten 75 secured a second straight IPL championship.
stories.summary: Virat Kohli was hailed as the "heartbeat" of the Royal Challengers Bengaluru dressing room after his unbeaten 75 secured a second straight IPL championship. The 37-year-old Kohli played a crucial role in Bengaluru's victory, chasing 156 to beat Gujarat Titans by five wickets in Sunday's final in Ahmedabad. Kohli was at the crease as his team achieved the winning total, earning praise from coach Andy Flower. This tribute acknowledges Kohli's significant contribution to the team's success, solidifying his position as a key player in the Royal Challengers Bengaluru dressing room. The win marks the team's second consecutive IPL championship, with Kohli's performance being a decisive factor in their triumph.

stories.headline: Hundreds arrested, dozens of police injured after Champions League riots A total of 219 people have been injured in clashes between football fans and police across France after Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) won the Champions League final
stories.summary: Clashes between football fans and police in France resulted in 219 injuries after Paris Saint-Germain's Champions League final win. A total of 890 people were arrested, and 178 security force members were injured in the widespread disorder. The violence occurred across France, with 692 fires reported. The unrest followed PSG's historic Champions League victory, with fans celebrating on the Champs-Elysees avenue and elsewhere. The situation turned violent, with flares and fireworks used, leading to a significant police response. The French interior ministry reported the extensive damage and casualties, highlighting the scale of the disturbances that followed the football match. Two people were also reported dead in the chaos that ensued after the game.

stories.headline: Arne Slot says his connection with Liverpool ‘goes beyond football’ after sacking Arne Slot has thanked Liverpool’s fans for making him ‘feel welcome from the start’ and underlined his pride at winning the title
stories.summary: Arne Slot has expressed his gratitude to Liverpool's fans, stating that his connection with the club "goes beyond football" after his sacking as head coach. The Dutchman was let go on Saturday, just 12 months after winning the club's second title in 35 years. Despite a disappointing defense of the title, which ended with a fifth-placed finish, Slot thanked the fans for making him "feel welcome from the start." He also expressed his pride in winning the title during his tenure. Slot's departure comes after a single season at Anfield, where he had achieved significant success initially but was ultimately unable to sustain it, leading to his dismissal. He has written an open letter to the supporters, bidding them farewell and acknowledging the special bond he formed with the club and its fans.

stories.headline: Jeremie Frimpong Speaks Out as His Reaction to Arsenal's UCL Final Loss Emerges Footage of Jeremie Frimpong celebrating Arsenal's Champions League final defeat emerged online.
stories.summary: Liverpool defender Jeremie Frimpong has responded to backlash after footage emerged of him celebrating Arsenal's Champions League final defeat to Paris Saint-Germain. The Dutchman was seen cheering after Gabriel Magalhaes missed a crucial penalty in Budapest, securing PSG's win. Frimpong uploaded a video of his reaction, which sparked a strong response from fans. He has since explained his actions, although the exact reasoning behind his celebration is not specified. The incident occurred after Arsenal's loss in the UEFA Champions League final, with Frimpong's reaction being widely shared on social media. The Liverpool star's response comes amid criticism from fans, who have questioned his decision to celebrate the defeat of a fellow English team. Frimpong's explanation has been shared online, although the details of his statement are not provided.

stories.headline: Justice Sanjay Karol Also Bars Senior Advocates From Appearing During Partial Court Working Days
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has barred senior advocates from mentioning or arguing cases during partial court working days until July 12. This decision aims to encourage younger lawyers to present their arguments. Justice Sanjay Karol and Justice AG Masih reiterated that cases would largely be argued by non-designated lawyers, citing the need to utilize vacation time effectively. Another bench comprising Justices P S Narasimha and Aravind Kumar also prohibited senior advocates from participating during partial court working days. A senior advocate had earlier informed the court of her intention to withdraw her matters due to the restriction on senior advocates. The move is intended to provide opportunities for younger lawyers to gain experience and argue cases in court. The restriction will be in place until July 12, with non-designated lawyers taking the lead in arguing cases during partial working days.

stories.headline: NEET-UG 2026 : Supreme Court Declines Prayer For Computer-Based Test For NEET Re-Exam
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has declined a petition seeking to shift the NEET UG 2026 re-exam to a Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode. The petition argued that repeated paper leak controversies and security lapses have exposed weaknesses in the current pen-and-paper format. However, the court refused to entertain the plea. Meanwhile, NTA officials assured a parliamentary committee that measures are in place to prevent paper leaks during the upcoming re-test, scheduled for June 21. The parliamentary committee is examining the pros and cons of pen-and-paper versus computer-based testing for national examinations, including the NEET UG. The Centre is also considering defence support for exam logistics to ensure the re-test is conducted smoothly and securely.

stories.headline: Got ₹7 lakh 'gifts', wanted car: UP woman found dead months after wedding with social media influencer
stories.summary: A 24-year-old social media influencer from Lucknow was found dead at her in-laws' house, barely six months after her marriage. Her family alleged murder and dowry harassment, claiming her husband and his relatives were demanding a car despite receiving ₹7 lakh in cash and gifts during the wedding. The woman's father stated that he had given the amount, but the husband's family later demanded a car in addition to the dowry already given. A case has been registered against the victim's husband, a social media influencer with 7.5 lakh followers, and five other relatives. The police are investigating the matter, with the family alleging that the woman was murdered over unmet dowry demands. The incident occurred in Saadatganj, Lucknow, where the woman had been living with her husband since their marriage on December 9, 2025.

stories.headline: Man sits on road as pregnant wife 'trapped' in traffic jam after VIP convoy stops vehicles in Bengaluru
stories.summary: A man travelling with his pregnant wife was stuck in a massive traffic jam on Bengaluru's Old Airport Road, reportedly caused by the movement of Karnataka Governor Thawarchand Gehlot's convoy on Sunday evening. The couple was left stranded for hours, prompting the man to stage a protest by sitting on the road. The traffic jam was a result of a zero-traffic arrangement for the governor's convoy. The incident sparked a debate about VIP culture and the restrictions imposed on ordinary commuters due to VIP movements. The man's protest was a brief standoff, but it highlighted the frustration of commuters who are often delayed due to such arrangements. The incident occurred on June 1, 2026, and has revived questions about the need for such restrictions. The governor's convoy had caused a significant disruption to traffic, leading to public anger.

stories.headline: The Same Wind Now Moves Oil, Rain And Power May revealed how oil, monsoon forecasts, geopolitics and monetary policy have become deeply interconnected.
stories.summary: India faces economic uncertainty due to rising fuel prices and a below-normal monsoon forecast for 2026. The ongoing conflict in West Asia has driven up oil prices, affecting India's economy. Despite a 14.68% drop in crude oil prices over the past month, they remain 49.64% higher than a year ago. The combination of high oil prices and monsoon concerns poses a challenge for India's growth momentum. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is exercising caution, and global conflicts are adding to the uncertainty. India must navigate these challenges while leveraging its resilience and strategic opportunities to maintain economic growth. The country's economic sentiment is being shaped by these interconnected factors, including oil price volatility, geopolitics, and monetary policy.

stories.headline: Top US Doctors Warn Shrinking Recess Time is Hurting Kids' Health, Learning and Emotional Growth
stories.summary: The American Academy of Pediatrics has issued new guidance stating that unstructured recess breaks are essential for children's focus, social skills, and physical health. Top US doctors warn that shrinking recess time is negatively impacting kids' health, learning, and emotional growth. Recess time has been decreasing over the years, but the new guidance emphasizes its importance. Unstructured breaks are said to improve children's ability to focus, develop social skills, and maintain physical health. The guidance comes as the US surgeon general post remains empty, highlighting the need for attention to children's health and wellbeing. Experts agree that providing adequate recess time is crucial for children's overall development, and efforts should be made to prioritize and protect this time in schools. The new guidance aims to raise awareness and promote positive change.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty extend losses as Middle East tensions fuel market uncertainty
stories.summary: Indian benchmark stock indices, Sensex and Nifty, have extended their losses for the fourth consecutive day due to selling in key sectors such as FMCG, financial, and auto. The decline is attributed to ongoing tensions in the Middle East, particularly between the US and Iran, which has led to increased uncertainty in the market. Crude oil prices have surpassed $110, exacerbating concerns over inflation and growth. The failure of US-Iran negotiations has heightened fears of a prolonged conflict, causing investors to panic. The Indian rupee has also hit a record low, further impacting the market. Despite a brief period of calm following a ceasefire extension, the situation remains volatile, contributing to the ongoing decline in Sensex and Nifty. The market continues to react to the evolving Middle East situation, driving the indices lower.

stories.headline: Stock market open 1 June 2026: Sensex rises nearly 600 points, Nifty jumps 185 points
stories.summary: The Sensex rose nearly 600 points to an intraday high of 75,367, while the Nifty gained 185 points to trade at 23,733. This represents a gain of almost 1 percent for both indices. The increase occurred amidst rising oil prices and ongoing geopolitical tensions. The Indian market has experienced volatility in recent months, with the Sensex previously surging 1,774 points from its lows to settle at 73,319. The Nifty has also seen significant fluctuations, closing around 23,700 in late trade. Gold rates in India currently stand at ₹1. The market's strong recovery comes after a period of uncertainty, with the Sensex climbing 567.99 points and the Nifty 50 advancing 172.35 points in a previous session on March 17, 2026.

stories.headline: Stock Market Opens Higher: Sensex Rises Over 400 Points, Nifty Reclaims 23,650 After MSCI-Led Friday's Selloff
stories.summary: The Indian stock market rebounded strongly, with the BSE Sensex rising over 400 points and the NSE Nifty reclaiming the 23,650 level. Led by gains in IT, auto, and financial stocks, the market recovered from Friday's selloff. The Sensex surged over 400 points, while the Nifty crossed 23,700 in early trade, driven by easing oil prices and positive Asian cues. Strong domestic institutional investor (DII) inflows offset foreign institutional investor (FII) selling, and the rupee rebounded sharply as global oil prices and bond yields cooled. The market's resilience was evident, with financial stocks leading the advances, while pharma and healthcare stocks lagged. The recovery marked a significant turnaround from the previous session's volatility, with the Sensex and Nifty posting modest gains amid hopes of easing geopolitical tensions.

stories.headline: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals tepid open on uncertainty over US-Iran deal; Kospi at new high
stories.summary: Indian stock markets are expected to open flat on a negative note amid mixed global cues, with the Nifty index signaling a gap down opening of about 70 points. The uncertainty over a US-Iran deal is contributing to market volatility, following a significant decline on Monday where the Sensex plunged over 1,800 points and the Nifty closed near 22,500. Global markets are also providing mixed signals, with the Kospi reaching a new high. The Indian stock market benchmark indices, Sensex and Nifty 50, are cautiously awaiting a final deal between Iran and the US, which is impacting investor sentiment. Other factors such as a weakening rupee and escalating tensions between Iran and the US are also weighing on the market. The market opening is expected to be tepid due to these uncertainties.

stories.headline: Oil Jumps on Report Iran to Halt Exchanges With US: Markets Wrap
stories.summary: Oil prices have surged following a report that Iran will halt exchanges with the US, casting doubt on a potential ceasefire renewal. The development has led to a renewed rally in oil prices, driving bonds lower and causing stocks to fluctuate. The escalation of tensions between the US and Iran follows recent US strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities. As a result, Wall Street has experienced gains, while oil prices have jumped. The halt in talks between Iran and the US has raised concerns about the potential for further conflict, contributing to the increase in oil prices. US stock futures have inched higher, although oil has pared back some of its early gains in response to the sudden US strikes over the weekend. The situation remains volatile, with markets reacting to the evolving geopolitical tensions.

stories.headline: DBS Plans Wealth-Center Buildout Across Asia
stories.summary: DBS Group will open 18 new wealth centres across Asia by the end of 2027, marking its largest physical expansion of its wealth franchise to date. The new centres will be located in Singapore, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Indonesia, and Taiwan. In addition to the new openings, DBS will also upgrade 36 existing wealth centres over the next 18 months. This expansion is in response to surging demand for wealth management services across Asia. The move aims to strengthen DBS's position as a leading wealth manager in the region. The bank, which is Southeast Asia's biggest by asset size, is investing in its wealth management business to capitalize on growing wealth in Asia. The expansion is expected to be completed by end-2027, with upgrades to existing centres finished within 18 months.

stories.headline: Datavault AI inks $2B structured financing term sheet
stories.summary: Datavault AI (NASDAQ: DVLT) signed a non-binding term sheet for a potential $2 billion structured financing deal. The agreement involves issuing shares at $1.55 to $2.00 per share to institutional investors. In exchange, Datavault AI would receive preferred units in a vehicle holding a $2 billion fixed-income portfolio. The deal is anchored by this portfolio and would route all global tokenization projects exclusively through Datavault's patented platform. The counterparty may also receive board control after all tranches close. The term sheet was executed on May 30, and the financing is expected to be dilutive. The deal is subject to negotiation and completion of definitive agreements. Datavault AI's stock price currently stands at $0.5401, with an 8.02% increase.

stories.headline: Zeekr's May deliveries hit record high as premium models drive growth
stories.summary: Zeekr delivered 34,377 vehicles in May, a year-on-year increase of 81.81%. This marks a record high for the company. Higher-priced models, specifically the 9 and 8 series, accounted for nearly half of the total deliveries, driving growth. As a premium EV brand owned by Geely Auto, Zeekr has achieved significant milestones, including being the world's fastest luxury battery electric vehicle brand to reach certain production targets since its first mass-produced model, the Zeekr 001, was released in October 2021. The recent delivery record follows the company's ongoing expansion and increasing demand for its premium electric vehicles.

stories.headline: SoftBank overtakes Toyota as Japan's most valuable company Fueled by its significant stake in AI powerhouse OpenAI, SoftBank Group has surged past Toyota to become Japan's most valuable company
stories.summary: SoftBank Group has surpassed Toyota as Japan's most valuable company, driven by its significant stake in AI powerhouse OpenAI. The company's market capitalization topped ¥48 trillion, exceeding Toyota's, for the first time in 23 years. SoftBank's stock climbed 14% on Monday, fueled by an 80% year-to-date rally. The surge is attributed to investor confidence in SoftBank's strategic stakes in OpenAI, valued at approximately $65 billion. This shift highlights the growing optimism over AI infrastructure and has reshuffled Japan's corporate hierarchy. As a result, SoftBank Group, led by Masayoshi Son, has become the country's most valuable firm, displacing Toyota Motor Corp. The Nikkei index also broke 67,000 for the first time, contributing to SoftBank's market cap increase.

stories.headline: OpenAI “Data Cartel” Protected by US Government, Whistleblower Says Artificial intelligence companies including OpenAI and Anthropic have scraped nearly all human knowledge from the internet with assistance from the U.S. government
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence companies, including OpenAI and Anthropic, have scraped nearly all human knowledge from the internet with US government assistance. A whistleblower claims the government is helping these companies sell the data back to the public, effectively creating a "data cartel." This comes after a June 2023 lawsuit alleged OpenAI scraped 300 billion words online without consent. The US government is accused of protecting these companies by waging "lawfare" against free alternatives, such as Anna's Archive, a self-described "largest truly open library in human history." The monopoly may face challenges from Chinese AI firms like DeepSeek and Quen, which have also collected similar information, potentially driving down costs. The whistleblower argues that the US is essentially granting OpenAI a monopoly on information, while alternative libraries are being suppressed. Chinese competitors may disrupt this monopoly in the future.
